The pencil strictness abbreviation has ssi/sss ambiguity; it is not normalized from mathematical meaning.
hand_habits: Low n and m strokes are often flattened almost horizontally; tall l and t remain much more conspicuous.
The g descender can return left beneath the word and mimic an underline; segment has such a return.
Several replacements are written above a horizontal cancellation; separate circles and leaders locate multi, distincts and the conn. addition.
The last e can be a long low horizontal exit, as in connexe.
A final q-like descender can survive below a heavy cancellation even when its bowl is obscured.
notes: Only scan005 packet, its drawing witness, shared RULES/PREAMBLE, and current notation were consulted. No other page packet or global witness was opened.
The full scan and two supplied halves were inspected once. Every agreeing source line was read, including formulas, primes, punctuation and cancelled material.

All 67 saved scan005 crops were autocontrasted from original full-image coordinates and enlarged with LANCZOS to a longest dimension of 2400 px, then inspected. The first Dualité and segm frames clipped part of the word; one corrected full-word frame for each was made. No settled reading was revisited to seek a different answer.
Four classification images were initially returned in an output discarded by context truncation; they were subsequently emitted in smaller groups and actually inspected once.
line_count counts 25 source-order main/heading/pencil reading units. Interlinear additions are recorded within the adjoining unit and separately in inventory; archive 4 is not an extra prose line.

against_c marks substantive alterations of C content or uncertainty state/order; it therefore includes resolutions and candidate reordering, not only replacement by a wholly new word. against_h marks a substantive incompatible or absent reading; H notes are not counted as source text.

H macro choices such as emph/uline, emptyset/varnothing, bold/double-struck R, or map spacing are not treated alone as content changes. An emphasis difference is recorded only when the asserted mark changes the reading of visible strokes.
No claim of proof verification is made. All mathematical content was transcribed from ink; mathematical plausibility did not select between doubtful glyphs.
The first overline comma is a departure from both witnesses. Its second-reader box contains the whole displayed condition; the doubt in the adjacent cancelled mark is retained.
The lower endpoint in the marginal drawing is open. The line-weight distinction is now reflected while preserving C’s endpoints, gap and third mark.
The pencil final parenthetical is inventoried as a lower note rather than silently classified as part of the blue main ink.

An attempted ancillary subdivision of already-decided phrase crops was stopped on the parent’s instruction that the existing phrase evidence was sufficient. Three partial word frames had been viewed; no reading decision changed. Six unused subdivision files and a partly clipped composantes frame were discarded, so they are not cited as evidence. The delivered evidence set remains the original 67 crops.
